caption: The drawing depicts an ornate chandelier suspended centrally within a rectangular, vertically oriented light beige or tan background with a fine outline bordering the composition. The chandelier features a central vertical stem with multiple tiers. Each tier is decorated with light blue-gray or silver arms that curve outward in a radial fashion and hold upright cylindrical candle holders colored pale yellow-gold to represent candles. The arms are further adorned with strings of round and oval glass-like beads or pendants rendered in light blue and gray tones, which drape between the arms and hang down at intervals. The top section of the chandelier has a decorative finial and additional vertical strings of beads. The lowest part of the chandelier is finished with a smaller inverted cup shape, also decorated with hanging beads. The entire drawing uses subtle shades of blue, gray, and white for the chandelier components, with a slight hint of shadow for depth, and the background remains plain with a faint tan gradient.
title: Chandelier
cluster: #16 — Lighting Devices: Lamps, Lanterns, and Candleholders
